name: sled 45° narrow stance leg press
description: A 45 degree sled leg press with feet close together. The narrow stance puts the focus on the quads.
instructions: Sit in the sled with your back flat against the pad and feet close together on the platform.
Lower the sled by bending your knees toward your chest.
Stop before your lower back lifts off the pad.
Press through your heels to extend your legs without locking the knees.
